component.name: VM Qontrol
component.summary: Create, run and fine-tune QEMU/KVM virtual machines

description.p: VM Qontrol makes and runs virtual machines on Linux with QEMU and KVM. Windows and the big Linux distributions install themselves, every setting says what it does and what is recommended, and machines from VMware, VirtualBox and virt-manager can be brought over.

Shared folders that appear in the machine by themselves (a drive in Windows, /mnt/shared in Linux), ready-made Linux machines from cloud images in seconds, machines saved when the computer shuts down, opening a machine's disk on this computer, a disks and discs manager, a tray icon, and a viewer that reopens at its last size.
The first release: create, run and fine-tune QEMU/KVM machines with unattended installs, snapshots, USB and device handover, library folders and keyboard shortcuts.
